findings.title: IPv4-mapped check skips BLOCKED_HOSTS so ::ffff:100.100.100.200 gets through
findings.problem: The new IPv4-mapped branch checks only is_link_local, is_loopback, is_unspecified and is_multicast on the mapped address. It never checks the mapped address against BLOCKED_HOSTS. 169.254.169.254 is still caught because it is link-local. The Alibaba metadata IP 100.100.100.200 is not link-local, so http://[::ffff:100.100.100.200] passes. Ran the validator in the repo venv (Python 3.11.14): returned (True, '').
findings.fix_hint: Normalize first: if the address is IPv4-mapped, set addr = addr.ipv4_mapped, then run both the BLOCKED_HOSTS check (str(addr)) and the property checks on the normalized address.
findings.why_it_matters: An attacker can still reach one of the four cloud-metadata hosts on the explicit blocklist by writing its IPv4-mapped IPv6 form, which is the kind of bypass this phase is meant to close.

members.title: IPv4-mapped check skips BLOCKED_HOSTS, so the mapped form of 100.100.100.200 passes
members.problem: The new branch unwraps addr.ipv4_mapped but runs only the link-local, loopback, unspecified and multicast checks on it. The BLOCKED_HOSTS lookup at line 77 is a plain string match against the raw hostname and runs before the unwrap. 100.100.100.200 (Alibaba metadata) is blocked only by that string match. Confirmed by running: validate_arr_url('http://[::ffff:100.100.100.200]') returns (True, ''). 169.254.169.254 is caught only because it happens to be link-local.

members.fix_hint: normalize to the mapped IPv4 (or canonical str(addr)) and re-check it against BLOCKED_HOSTS as well as the property checks

members.title: Apply the explicit metadata blocklist to mapped addresses
members.problem: The new mapped-address branch checks address categories but omits BLOCKED_HOSTS. Reproduced: http://100.100.100.200 is rejected, while http://[::ffff:100.100.100.200] and http://[::ffff:6464:64c8] are accepted. These represent the same destination, leaving the metadata SSRF bypass open on deployments that can reach it. Settings accepts and persists these URLs.

members.title: SSRF bypass: IPv6 literal forms other than ::ffff:0:0/96 smuggle blocked IPv4 addresses past validation
members.problem: The new mitigation only unwraps the RFC 4291 IPv4-mapped prefix (::ffff:0:0/96 via addr.ipv4_mapped). It misses the deprecated IPv4-compatible form (::a.b.c.d, ::/96 excluding ::1) and the NAT64 well-known prefix (64:ff9b::a.b.c.d). Verified: ipaddress.ip_address('::127.0.0.1') and ipaddress.ip_address('64:ff9b::169.254.169.254') parse as IPv6Address with is_loopback, is_link_local, is_unspecified, is_multicast all False and ipv4_mapped None. urlparse strips the brackets cleanly, so http://[::127.0.0.1]:7878/ or http://[64:ff9b::169.254.169.254]/ passes validate_arr_url.

members.why_it_matters: This is exactly the class of bug this diff was written to fix, but the fix is incomplete: an attacker with access to the settings form can still reach loopback services or the cloud metadata endpoint by wrapping the target in an IPv6 literal form the code doesn't recognize.
members.fix_hint: Extract the embedded IPv4 for all embedding forms, not just ::ffff:0:0/96: check addr.ipv4_mapped, and for any IPv6Address whose .packed[:12] is all zero (deprecated ::/96 compat form, excluding ::1) or matches the NAT64 prefix 64:ff9b::/96, reconstruct an IPv4Address from the last 4 bytes and apply the same checks.

members.title: IPv4-mapped unwrapping reapplies the predicate but skips the BLOCKED_HOSTS literal check
members.problem: The new branch unwraps ::ffff:a.b.c.d and re-runs only the four is_* checks. It never looks the unwrapped IPv4 up in BLOCKED_HOSTS (line 77). 100.100.100.200 (Alibaba Cloud metadata, CGNAT 100.64/10) is not link-local, loopback, unspecified or multicast, so http://[::ffff:100.100.100.200]/ passes even though plain http://100.100.100.200/ is rejected. Same for ::ffff:6464:64c8 (hex form).

members.why_it_matters: The goal is that the mapped form of an address gets the same treatment as the plain form. Blocking four categories but not the explicit metadata denylist breaks that for a known-targeted cloud-metadata endpoint.
members.fix_hint: normalize once (addr = addr.ipv4_mapped or addr), then run both the BLOCKED_HOSTS membership check (str(addr)) and the is_* predicate on the normalized address
